headline: PlayStation Network experiencing massive outage affecting all services
summary: Players are unable to log in, play online, or access the PlayStation Store, with impacts felt even at major esports events.
details: The PlayStation Network (PSN) is currently suffering a widespread outage, impacting all of Sony's gaming services. Users are reporting issues with account management, online play, and purchasing games from the PlayStation Store.
Sony's official service status page confirms that 'all services are experiencing issues.' This outage affects a range of platforms, including the PS Vita, PS4, and PS3, in addition to the latest PS5.

The disruption has already had real-world consequences, notably delaying the EA Sports FC 26 championship at the Esports World Cup. This highlights the critical reliance on PSN for competitive gaming events.

The outage comes at an awkward time, as Sony recently announced plans to phase out physical game disc production by 2028, shifting towards a fully digital ecosystem. Network outages directly expose the vulnerability of an all-digital model.

Sony has yet to issue a public statement on its PlayStation Support account regarding the outage, but the company has been contacted for comment. Updates will be provided as more information becomes available.
